one_liner: Senior executive-level manager who leads the Defense Contract Audit Agency's data, analytics, and AI strategy and supervises four GS-14 branch chiefs at Fort Belvoir.
fit_summary: This GS-15 role requires a year of GS-14-equivalent experience setting enterprise data/AI strategy, directing technology portfolios through subordinate supervisors, or advising executives as a principal. Daniel's known background (emergency-management consulting at IEM, policy knowledge, relationship-building) does not show that level of technical leadership or supervision of supervisors. The stakeholder-engagement option is the only plausible angle, and it still demands executive-level, high-profile representation.
eligibility: Open to the public (U.S. citizens); no federal status or veterans' preference needed, but preference-eligible veterans get priority within categories.
One year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-14 is required; education cannot substitute.
Requires eligibility for a Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) clearance, which means a Top Secret-level background investigation.
Reemployed annuitants are not eligible for this vacancy.
keywords: enterprise-wide digital, data, or artificial intelligence strategies
strategy: Before investing time, honestly check whether any IEM work involved directing technology or data programs, managing other managers, or advising government executives; if not, skip this and target GS-9 to GS-12 emergency management or program analyst roles.

If you apply, frame IEM experience around the third specialized-experience option: describe [specific government clients], the seniority of the officials you advised, and any agreements you negotiated or adoption efforts you led.
State dates, hours per week, title, and scope briefly so the whole resume fits OPM's two-page USAJOBS limit, with GS-14-level responsibility clear in the first lines of each job.
Preview the questionnaire at the linked USA Staffing URL and answer only at levels you can document; the posting warns inflated ratings will be lowered.
Prepare for the USA Hire assessment and apply between October 29 and November 12, 2026, well before the deadline.
resume_bullets: Advised [title/level of client officials] at [agency/jurisdiction] on [disaster recovery or preparedness program], presenting recommendations to [executive body or panel] that informed [decision or policy].
Built coalitions among [number] federal, state, and local stakeholders to negotiate [agreement or plan], driving adoption of [tool, process, or digital system] across [scope].
Managed [budget amount] in [program/task order] resources, tracking [performance metrics] and adjusting staff and funding as [client priorities] changed.
interview_questions: Describe how you developed and gained buy-in for an enterprise-wide data or AI strategy.
How have you managed subordinate supervisors and handled performance issues in a multi-branch organization?
Tell us about a time you overcame workforce resistance to adopting new technology.
How do you weigh legal, cybersecurity, and mission risk when recommending scaling an AI pilot?
watch_outs: The GS-14-equivalent specialized experience bar is very high and Daniel's known background likely won't meet it.
SCI clearance is required, which adds a lengthy investigation and possible delays.
No telework and fully on-site at Fort Belvoir, a commute from Manassas that is manageable but daily.
Short two-week window (October 29 to November 12, 2026) plus a USA Hire assessment to complete.
